svg.title: Word Hunt autoplay demo
svg.text: Esc, the hotkey, or touching the mouse stops a game.
READY: start a Word Hunt game, then press ctrl+alt+p. Ctrl+C quits.
R E S O 476 words, 424,400 points on the board
C A E R game clock 01:18
What happens when you press the hotkey
Press ctrl+alt+p once the game has started
It screenshots the board, reads it with Apple Vision and solves it
It swipes the best words first, until the clock is about to run out
